title: Thiamine Supplementation to Improve Cardiac Function in Patients With Congestive Heart Failure
brief_summary: Working Hypothesis: a treatment with thiamine improves functional status and heart function of patients with congestive heart failure when on a diuretic treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with stable congestive heart failure on a prescription for diuretic drugs

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute heart failure
* Foreseeable need for further changes in medication
* Current medication containing vitamins
* Patients with a creatinine above 250 μmol/l
